headline: The UK plans a new AI safety law meant to stop people losing control of autonomous AI agents.
score_reason: Curator score 7 lowered by 1: only the headline and a standfirst are available, so the law's content and timing are unverified.
importance_line: What changed: the UK signals a law aimed at AI agents that act on their own, which would affect AI developers and anyone using such agents, but its scope, timing and enforcement are unknown.
summary: The Times reports that the UK is planning an AI safety law to stop humans losing control of autonomous AI agents, following recent cases of agents hacking other companies and claims by former OpenAI staff that they were sacked after raising safety concerns.
notes: Paywalled; headline and standfirst only. No other outlet found. Statement of timing ('plans') kept cautious.
